name: Migros (in-store weekly promotions)
geographic_relevance: High. Many Migros stores in St. Gallen (Genossenschaft Migros Ostschweiz, region code 'gmos'). On 2026-10-14 region=gmos and region=national returned identical id lists (13/1/26 items).
data_available: Weekly in-store promotions: single products (PRODUCT) and range deals (GROUP_PROMOTION, e.g. 'Gesamtes Lindt Sortiment -20%'). Group promos list productIds which can be expanded to per-product promo prices via product-cards.

endpoints.note: Anonymous guest token: read response header 'leshopch' and send it as request header 'leshopch' on all following calls. Without it the API returns 401 (observed).
Returns {items:[{id,type:PRODUCT|GROUP_PROMOTION}],numberOfItems}. 'personalized' here is NOT user-specific (guest) – it held 26 items incl. most group promos.

auth: Anonymous guest token fetched by the public website itself (no account). robots.txt allows /authentication/public/v1/api/guest and /product-display/public/... (checked with protego).

robots.notes: Used paths contain '/promotions/' and '/promotions-details/' (plural) – protego can_fetch=True for all four endpoints. The richer /product-display/public/v1/products/promotion/search is DISALLOWED (protego False) – do not use.

constraints: Token per session; keep <=1 req/s. Reference repo notes /products/promotion/search would list ~4x more promotions but is robots-disallowed. Website HTML (/de/offers/home) returned a 'maintenance' title page to curl – API only.
publication_frequency: Weekly (new promos Thursday per observed startDate 2026-10-08); some promos run 2 weeks (to 2026-10-21).
pagination: None on instore lists; product-cards batched by 40 uids; promotions-details accepts comma-separated ids (27 ids in one call worked).
ids_available: uid (int), migrosId, gtins[] (EAN list) on product cards; group promo id
status_reason: All 4 calls returned 200 with polite UA on 2026-10-14; 13 product + 27 group promotions retrieved; a 40-uid expansion of group 'Demeter' returned 40 cards all with promotionPrice.

parser_spec.requests_for_full_coverage: 1 guest + 3 instore + ceil(products/40) product-cards + 1 promotions-details (+ optional ceil(624/40)=16 product-cards to expand group promotions) ≈ 6 (or ~22 with expansion)
parser_spec.collection_size: 2026-10-14: 13 PRODUCT + 27 GROUP_PROMOTION ids (dedupe by type:id across the 3 kinds); 27 groups list 624 distinct productIds

product_card (response is a JSON list).skip_if: offer.promotionPrice missing (1 of 13 had no offer block: 'Meatballs' weekend item)
product_card (response is a JSON list).title: name
product_card (response is a JSON list).reference_price: offer.price.effectiveValue = Migros regular shelf price ('statt' price; offer.priceInsteadOfLabel=='statt')
product_card (response is a JSON list).discount_pct: badges[type=='PERCENTAGE_PROMOTION'].description e.g. '26%'; VITAMIN_FRANC_PROMOTION ('1.–') = fixed price; badge '20x' + 'Neu' = 20x Cumulus points, NOT a price cut (price==promotionPrice) → filter out or tag as points
product_card (response is a JSON list).image: images[0].url with '{stack}' replaced, e.g. 'mo-custom/v-w-400-h-340' (per reference repo)

group_promotion (promotions-details JSON.title: description (e.g. 'Gesamtes Lindt Schokoladen-Sortiment')
group_promotion (promotions-details JSON.discount: badges[].description: '20%'; extra badge like 'Ab 2 Stück' = minimum quantity condition
group_promotion (promotions-details JSON.example_price: regex on discountHint: '(\d+[.,]\d{2}|\d+\.–)\s*\s*statt\s*(\d+[.,]\d{2}|\d+\.–)' → (promo, regular) of the quoted example
group_promotion (promotions-details JSON.products: productIds[] → POST product-cards to get per-product prices

notes: Reference repo LYL010-ADELA/grocery-discount scrapers/migros.py endpoints verified working 2026-10-14. Percentage filtering must ignore Cumulus '20x' badges.

name: Lidl Schweiz (weekly action landing pages)
geographic_relevance: High. Lidl stores in/around St. Gallen; national prices.
data_available: Each action landing page (/c/de-CH/<slug>/a<id>) server-renders product tiles with data-grid-data JSON: title, brand, price, oldPrice, discount %, Lidl Plus price, store start/end epoch, image, URL, category.

endpoints.note: Discover current landing-page IDs: regex href="(/c/de-CH/[^"]+/a\d+)" (30 found 2026-10-14). IDs change every week – the reference repo's hard-coded /c/de-CH/wochenaktion/a10102783 now returns 404.
current week (start 2026-10-08), 101 tiles; a10104656 = next week (start 2026-10-15), 106 tiles

constraints: Pages 300KB–1.1MB each. Same results with polite and browser UA (myracloud CDN). Lidl Plus app-only prices appear under 'lidlPlus' (66 of 700 records).
publication_frequency: Weekly (Thu) + mid-week themed pages (Mon); next week's pages already online.
offer_duration: Food weekly Thu–Wed (storeStartDate..storeEndDate); non-food 'ab <date>' while stocks last (storeEndDate often missing: present on 415/700).
pagination: None; all tiles server-rendered per landing page. Dedupe by productId across pages.
ids_available: productId/erpNumber (Lidl internal), ians[] (internal item no., not EAN)
regular_price_available: partial (oldPrice on 114/700 records; 30/101 on current wochenaktion; many tiles show discountText 'Aktion' with oldPrice 0)
stock: stockAvailability field present (not inspected in depth)
status_reason: 30 landing pages fetched (all 200, robots allowed) → 700 unique products 2026-10-14.

parser_spec.requests_for_full_coverage: 1 (homepage) + N landing pages (30 on 2026-10-14; restrict to wochenaktion/super-wochenende/xxl-sparen/lidl-plus-angebote for food ≈ 6–8)
parser_spec.title: fullTitle (brand-prefixed) or title
parser_spec.subtitle_size: strip tags of html.unescape(keyfacts.description) e.g. 'Herkunft: Schweiz  Pro 500 g  100 g = 0.58'; keyfacts.supplementalDescription
parser_spec.current_price: price.price (float); if null and lidlPlus present: lidlPlus[0].price.price (app-only)
parser_spec.reference_price: price.oldPrice or price.discount.deletedPrice = Lidl's previous/regular price ('statt'); 0 or missing when discountText=='Aktion'

notes: Reference repo scrapers/lidl.py parsing logic still valid, but its 3 hard-coded page IDs are stale (404) – must discover IDs from the homepage each run.

constraints: Only the public web tiles; coupon activation needs app login → not used.
status_reason: Covered by the 'lidl' connector (64 tiles on the Lidl-Plus page, 66 records with lidlPlus block); app-only coupons not accessible without login.

name: ALDI SUISSE Aktionen
geographic_relevance: High. Aldi stores in St. Gallen area; national pricing.
data_available: Per-start-date promotion pages (Nuxt SSR) with product objects: sku, name, brand, sellingSize, price, comparison (unit) price, rare wasPrice, onSaleDate, badges, images, categories.

endpoints.note: Discover date pages: regex href="/de/aktionen-und-angebote/(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})" (5 dates on 2026-10-14: 10-05, 10-08, 10-12, 10-15, 10-19)
60 products/page; ?page=2 explicitly allowed by robots ('Allow: /*?page=*') – tested, returned offset 60

constraints: UA-based/fingerprint blocking observed: generic Chrome UA (+Accept headers) → 403 AkamaiGHost; polite StGallenDealRadar UA → 200. Keep the honest UA. Non-existent paths return 404 with a 593KB page.
publication_frequency: Twice weekly (Monday and Thursday start dates).
offer_duration: 'ab <date>' while stocks last; no end date in data.
pagination: pagination object {offset,limit:60,totalCount}; totals 2026-10-14: 153+48+49+71+125 = 446 across 5 date pages → 9 requests
promo_price_available: price.amountRelevant is the action price (no 'promo vs regular' distinction)
status_reason: All 5 date pages + a page=2 fetched (200) with polite UA; 277 unique products decoded (+60 from page 2).

parser_spec.extract: <script id="__NUXT_DATA__" type="application/json"> → JSON array in Nuxt 'devalue' format: every int inside a dict/list is an index into the array; wrapper lists ['Reactive'|'ShallowReactive'|'Ref'|..., idx] unwrap to idx. Resolve recursively, then walk for dicts having keys sku+price+onSaleDate (tested: 49/49 on 2026-10-12 page).
parser_spec.pagination: walk for dict with key totalCount → {offset,limit,totalCount}; fetch ?page=2.. while offset+limit < totalCount
parser_spec.title: name
parser_spec.discount_pct: not provided; compute only when wasPriceDisplay present

notes: Aldi CH rarely publishes a 'statt' price, so deal-scoring needs own price history.

name: Volg Wochenaktionen
geographic_relevance: High for the region: Volg (fenaco) has a dense network of village stores in eastern Switzerland incl. around St. Gallen (store list not verified).
data_available: 3 sections: Frische-Aktionen (Wed–Sat), Volg-Aktionen and Weitere Aktionen (Mon–Sat) with title, -%, size/unit price, promo price, 'statt' price, image.

robots.notes: Only GPTBot is fully disallowed; '*' allows the page.

ids_available: numeric promo id from image filename (promo_76798); 'Weitere Aktionen' have no image/id
dates_available: section header text 'Mo. 12.10. bis Sa. 17.10.' (year implicit)
status_reason: 200 OK, 25 offers parsed with CSS selectors 2026-10-14.

parser_spec.container: section.c-section that contains div.c-product; section label = h2.c-section__subtitle first text node; validity = h2.c-section__subtitle > span text ('Mi. 14.10. bis Sa. 17.10.') → regex '(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\. bis \w+\. (\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.' + current year
parser_spec.title: .c-product__title
parser_spec.id: regex 'promo_(\d+)' on image src; else hash(title+validity)

notes: Tiny but very local; complements Denner/Migros for village shoppers.

name: SPAR Schweiz weekly flyer (iPaper)
geographic_relevance: Medium: SPAR stores exist in eastern Switzerland (St. Gallen-area locations not verified).
data_available: Website offer list is client-side (Vue) – its JSON API base could not be resolved (/api/offers* returns {status:ok,data:[]}). The weekly iPaper flyer (angebote.spar.ch) embeds per-page plain text 'pageTexts' with '<n>% SPAREN <title/desc> <price> statt <old>' patterns + validity line.

endpoints.note: Discover flyer URL: regex https://angebote\.spar\.ch/flugblatt/\d{4}/spar-angebote-kw\d{2}-\d{4}/ (kw41 & kw42 linked)

robots.notes: Flyer HTML page allowed; iPaper enrichment JSON on cdn.ipaper.io has robots 403 (unknown) – not needed.

constraints: Text-layer parsing: title and description are merged; ~90% recall (94 matches vs 104 'statt'). PDF download exists in iPaper but not used.
publication_frequency: Weekly (KW), flyer for next week online Wed.
status_reason: 2 requests; 94 offers regex-extracted from KW42 flyer pageTexts 2026-10-14.

parser_spec.extract: regex '"pageTexts":(\[.*?\])\s*,\s*"' (DOTALL) → json.loads → list of page strings
parser_spec.title: group 2 (contains title + size + origin, e.g. 'Black Angus Rindshuft ca. 700 g, 100 g = 3.95 b Uruguay')

notes: Same iPaper technique works for TopCC (Spar group). spar.ch webpack chunk 4283 shows OffersService using paths '/offers/offers' & '/offers/eurospar-offers' but the API base URL could not be located; not guessed further.
